es: Formular propuestas, condiciones y contraofertas con I'd suggest, how about, as long as, provided that y meet halfway.

teaching.en: I'd suggest we share the bathroom rota.
teaching.es: Yo sugeriría que compartamos el turno de limpieza del baño.
teaching.explanationEs: I'd suggest + we + verbo base: una propuesta suave, sin will ni to.
teaching.audioText: I'd suggest we share the bathroom rota.

teaching.en: How about a deal: you cook on Mondays and I cook on Thursdays?
teaching.es: ¿Qué tal un trato: tú cocinas los lunes y yo los jueves?
teaching.explanationEs: How about + nombre o -ing: una oferta en forma de pregunta.
segments: How about a deal: you cook on
Mondays and I cook on Thursdays?
teaching.audioText: How about a deal: you cook on Mondays and I cook on Thursdays?

teaching.en: My condition is simple: you can have friends over as long as they leave before eleven.
teaching.es: Mi condición es sencilla: puedes invitar a amigos siempre que se vayan antes de las once.
teaching.explanationEs: As long as + oración en presente: la oferta vale solo si se cumple.
segments: My condition is simple: you can have friends
over as long as they leave before eleven.
teaching.audioText: My condition is simple: you can have friends over as long as they leave before eleven.

teaching.en: We can keep the cheaper plan, provided that everyone pays on time; otherwise, we change it.
teaching.es: Podemos mantener el plan más barato, siempre y cuando todos paguen a tiempo; de lo contrario, lo cambiamos.
teaching.explanationEs: Provided that es más formal que as long as; otherwise dice qué pasa si no se cumple.
segments: We can keep the cheaper plan, provided that
everyone pays on time; otherwise, we change it.
teaching.audioText: We can keep the cheaper plan, provided that everyone pays on time; otherwise, we change it.

teaching.en: Let's meet halfway: I wash the dishes on weekdays, and you wash them at weekends.
teaching.es: Lleguemos a un punto medio: yo friego los platos entre semana y tú los fines de semana.
teaching.explanationEs: Meet halfway: cada parte cede algo hasta un punto intermedio.
segments: Let's meet halfway: I wash the dishes on
weekdays, and you wash them at weekends.
teaching.audioText: Let's meet halfway: I wash the dishes on weekdays, and you wash them at weekends.

teaching.en: Tom's counteroffer was fair: he pays more, and in return he gets the bigger room.
teaching.es: La contraoferta de Tom fue justa: paga más y, a cambio, se queda con la habitación más grande.
teaching.explanationEs: In return añade lo que se recibe a cambio de ceder algo.
segments: Tom's counteroffer was fair: he pays more, and
in return he gets the bigger room.
teaching.audioText: Tom's counteroffer was fair: he pays more, and in return he gets the bigger room.

prompt.es: Completa: «Te sugiero que compartamos el turno.»

feedback.es: I'd suggest + we + verbo base es la fórmula de la propuesta suave.

hint.es: Es el verbo de proponer con suavidad: I'd ___ + we…

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase pone una condición para usar la sala de estudio?

choices.text: You can use the room as long as you will clean it.
You can use the room as long as you clean it.
You can use the room as long as cleaning it.

feedback.es: Tras as long as va una oración en presente: as long as you clean it. Con will o con -ing la frase no es correcta.

hint.es: Tras as long as va sujeto + verbo en presente.

origin.text: Sara comparte la sala de estudio con Carlos.

prompt.es: Ordena: «¿Qué tal si cocinamos por turnos?»

feedback.es: How about + -ing introduce la oferta en forma de pregunta.

hint.es: Empieza con las dos palabras que abren la oferta.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué condición pone la frase.

choices.text: The plan becomes cheaper every month.
All the flatmates pay on time.

feedback.es: Provided that introduce la condición: que todos paguen a tiempo. Lo demás no se menciona como condición.

origin.audio: I'd suggest we keep the cheaper plan, provided that everyone pays on time.

prompt.es: Completa: «Puedes usar mi bici, siempre y cuando la devuelvas hoy.»

feedback.es: Provided that significa «siempre y cuando» y va seguido de una oración en presente.

origin.text: You can use my bike, ___ that you bring it back today.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con su función en la negociación.

pairs: as long as you clean it

pairs.es: dice qué pasa si no se cumple

feedback.es: Cada expresión cumple un papel: proponer, condicionar, repartir la cesión o avisar de la consecuencia.

pairs: as long as you clean it

pairs.es: dice qué pasa si no se cumple

prompt.es: Ana paga 300 libras y quiere pagar 250; ¿qué contraoferta es el punto medio?

feedback.es: El punto medio entre 250 y 300 es 275. «How about £350?» sube el precio y «Let's keep £300» no cede nada.

origin.text: Ana paga £300 por su cuarto y quiere pagar £250. Tom dice que el cuarto vale £300.

prompt.es: Completa: «Paga antes del viernes; de lo contrario, cambiamos de plan.»

feedback.es: Otherwise expresa lo que pasa si la condición no se cumple.

origin.text: Please pay before Friday. ___, we change the plan.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué condición pone la persona.

choices.text: The listener pays for the boxes.
The listener helps carry the boxes.

feedback.es: Provided that introduce la condición: que la otra persona ayude a llevar las cajas.

origin.audio: Sunday is difficult for me. How about Saturday morning, provided that you help me carry the boxes?

prompt.es: Ofrece tu portátil con una condición: que lo cuide.

answer.text: You can use my laptop as long as you look after it.
accepted: You can use my laptop as long as you look after it.
You can use my laptop provided that you look after it.
You can use my laptop as long as you take care of it.
You can use my laptop provided that you take care of it.
You can use my laptop, as long as you look after it.
You can use my laptop providing that you look after it.
You can use my laptop as long as you are careful with it.

feedback.es: La oferta lleva la condición con as long as o provided that, seguida de presente sin will.

origin.text: Tu compañero quiere usar tu portátil. Ofrécelo con una condición: que lo cuide.

prompt.es: Carlos odia fregar cada día; ¿qué respuesta propone un reparto razonable?

choices.text: How about you wash them always?
How about wash them in turns?
How about washing them in turns, one day each?

feedback.es: How about + -ing propone un reparto por turnos. «How about you wash them always?» no cede nada y «How about wash them…» no usa -ing.

origin.text: Carlos: "I hate washing the dishes every day."

prompt.es: Ordena: «Lleguemos a un punto medio: tú cocinas y yo friego.»

answer.text: Let's meet halfway you cook and I wash up

feedback.es: Let's meet halfway abre el reparto en el que cada parte hace algo.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase sobre quedarse en el piso es correcta?

choices.text: You can stay provided that you pay your part.
You can stay provided that you will pay your part.
You can stay provided that to pay your part.

feedback.es: Provided that se sigue de una oración en presente: you pay your part. Will y to + verbo no son correctos aquí.
